$Comment: What Christmas Carols pays, once in each run of Christmas. The one roll always pays Christmas Coins
and festival tokens through the Currency reward kind. Favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor
ride the quest's own Rewards, where the quest card shows them. The candy cane each carol line hands
over every day is the line's own (DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Carol.json), not this
table's. A companion mod adds rolls of its own with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Christmas_Carols_Pay
